risk_assessment.rationale: The correlation of 32 scan attempts from an unverified source (IP 203.0.113.10) provides high confidence that this activity represents a significant security risk.

Escalate to the incident response / Tier 2 team

recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Immediately initiate a forced password reset for account 'jsmith' and invalidate all current active sessions.
Conduct a forensic review of the shell history and system logs for user 'jsmith' starting from the timestamp of the successful login to identify any unauthorized commands or lateral movement.
Cross-reference the source IP (203.0.113.10) against internal access logs to see if it has interacted with other systems in the network.
Verify if Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) was enabled for this account; if so, determine if the MFA challenge was bypassed or successfully completed by the attacker.
Implement a temporary block on IP 203.0.113.10 at the perimeter firewall until further investigation is complete.
Notify the user 'jsmith' via an out-of-band communication channel to confirm whether they were performing remote maintenance at the time of the login.
triage_rationale_experimental: The high volume of preceding scan activity followed by a successful login from an unverified source strongly indicates a successful brute-force or credential stuffing attack.
